text_block_list.text:
After the Arima Kinen race— The vital 
first three years of the Twinkle Series 
were drawing to a close...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if my three-year journey... h-has 
managed to leave behind a respectable set 
of hoofprints...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I was able to win consecutive Grand Prix 
titles... as well as GⅠs along the Triple 
Tiara route...
choice_data_list:
That's it, total domination of the Tiara 
line GⅠ races!

Right, a total sweep of all the Tiara 
route GⅠ races!

text_block_list.text:
It is far more than "decent." Her race 
record is a glorious one that will go down 
in history!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! It's all thanks to you, 
Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It is the fruit of both of your hard work 
and bond. Congratulations—Chrono-san."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I have mixed feelings about 30 
miles, but... Chrono-chan, congrats!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
We've definitely gotta celebrate this! 
—Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you made Chrono-chan worry sooo 
much! So make sure to give her some proper 
TLC, okay? ♡

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...! Never mind me, please treat 
your injuries first...!
choice_data_list:
No! Let's give you a proper celebration 
next time, Chrono!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Um... A-Are you sure it's alright...?

Due to the hospital's curfew that day, the 
celebration had to be postponed to another 
day.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you were able to be discharged 
before the end of the year...! Ah, please 
watch your step...

Thanks to dedicating myself to rehab, I 
was able to be discharged right at the end 
of the year.

Chrono Genesis had come to help with my 
discharge. I got into a taxi with her in 
front of the hospital and gave the driver 
our destination.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...? ...Are we not returning to Tracen 
Academy...?
choice_data_list:
We promised, didn't we? Chrono's 
celebration!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Is this...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, where the Arima Kinen bracket 
lottery took place.

text_block_list.text:
The public post-position draw for the 
Arima Kinen was held in the large hall 
here. Today's destination, however, is the 
tearoom in the same building.
choice_data_list:
...I just wanted to overwrite your 
memories with new ones.

text_block_list.text:
Until next year's Arima Kinen, painful 
memories would resurface every time I saw 
this place... I didn't want to just leave 
it like that.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: So let's make some fun memories today!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

As if the bustling year-end rush of the 
town were an illusion, the tearoom was 
tranquil. It looks like we can spend a 
peaceful time here.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Wah... How lovely... The interior is so 
elaborate, too...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I-It's so prestigious, I'm feeling a 
little... nervous...
choice_data_list:
Yeah... Me too. I'm not used to this, so 
I'm nervous...

Yeah... Me too. I'm not used to this, so 
I'm nervous...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: You too, Trainer...? Hu... Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... Well then... Since neither 
of us is used to this, let's pretend not 
to notice any blunders... and just take it 
easy.
choice_data_list:
Once you're healed, let's go somewhere 
together.

text_block_list.text:
Spending a full day out having fun might 
not be bad. If it's a theme park, they 
sometimes keep the illumination shows 
going well after New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Illuminations...! Sounds wonderful...! 
Oi's lights are definitely a sight to 
behold...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
!! N-No...! J-Just now... p-please forget 
that...!
choice_data_list: Then let's go see the Oi illuminations.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes.... Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely aroma... I think I'll take 
this one straight...
choice_data_list: Do you usually put sugar or milk in it?
Do you usually add sugar or milk?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I don't take sugar, but... I usually have 
milk tea or lemon tea.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...And what about you, Trainer? I-Is there 
a tea snack that you prefer...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-What kind of dishes do you like...? If 
you could also tell me... your flavor 
preferences...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...'G-Good running comes from good 
nutrition,' that was the motto of the club 
I used to belong to... So I know recipes 
that are healthy for the body..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I-If it wouldn't be a bother... would 
it be all right if I brought you... a 
boxed lunch...?"
choice_data_list: Are you sure?! Absolutely! Thank you!
Are you sure?! I'd love to! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! Ehehe... I'll do my best...!
choice_data_list:
At this rate, I can't tell who we're 
celebrating for.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...For me, having you here by my side like 
this, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It is a celebration that makes me happier 
than anything...!
